architecture.class: plug-and-play streaming semantic VAD / dialogue-state predictor coupled with streaming ASR
architecture.purpose: low-latency semantic-aware turn management for full-duplex spoken dialogue
architecture.training_code_status: official repository reports training code released 2026-07-17
architecture.local_deployment_status: official repository provides local Linux installation, model download and streaming inference server instructions

language_support.runtime_configuration_evidence: official configuration recommends Paraformer for Chinese, SenseVoice language=en for English, and SenseVoice language=auto for bilingual use; no German path is declared
language_support.trigger7_implication: No German-first production, benchmark or Trigger-4 promotion credit is supported at source scope.

evaluation_boundary.upstream_claim: paper reports low-latency streaming dialogue-state control and improved overall turn-management/latency results on its released evaluation setting

donor_value.high_value_mechanism: small streaming semantic state predictor that uses partial textual/ASR evidence instead of relying only on acoustic silence
donor_value.frankenstein_mapping: candidate donor for semantic endpointing, WAIT/continue-vs-commit arbitration and interruption policy while preserving Frankenstein state/effect authority
donor_value.adaptation_note: the released training code makes a separate German adaptation/fine-tune research lane technically more plausible than runtime-testing the unadapted bilingual checkpoint

hypothesis: A SoulX-Duplug-style 0.6B streaming semantic state predictor could reduce false endpoints and improve Frankenstein turn-taking if adapted to German and fused with the existing VoiceIntent/GWT/WAIT policy rather than used as a direct action authority.
counterhypothesis: The predictor may encode English/Chinese ASR-text cues strongly enough that German adaptation requires substantial data and tuning, while a simpler German streaming ASR plus deterministic acoustic/semantic endpoint policy could achieve equal or better latency and robustness with less runtime cost.
next_discriminator: Do not dispatch the unadapted SoulX-Duplug-0.6B checkpoint merely to test German that upstream does not claim. Preserve the semantic-VAD/state-prediction architecture as a donor and reopen only under a distinct German adaptation objective with German data and a pinned baseline. Continue consuming existing Qwen3-ASR target run 33292903286 after the self-hosted runner/control-plane gate resolves; do not duplicate that run.
